original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production character assets for Magnus Thorne, a 34-year-old adult male. Image 1 is the APPROVED HEAD MASTER: reproduce this exact mature face, longer uncompressed skull, warm bronze complexion, amber-brown eyes, thick brows, short black swept-back hair with the same loose forehead strands, moustache and stubble. The tall black/charcoal wolf ears have exactly its length, root spacing and gently inward tips; no shortening or spreading. Image 2 is approved BODY and wardrobe authority: tall 193cm athletic broad-shouldered 8-9 human-head proportions (ears excluded), black tailored three-piece suit, charcoal shirt, loose black tie, watch, black Oxford shoes. Single enormous fluffy dark C-curved wolf tail. Human anatomy and human face, only wolf ears and tail. Premium high-detail otome 2.5D/3D render, crisp strands and facial detail, same lighting and material finish as portrait. White seamless studio. No captions, letters, watermarks. Do not change hairstyle or turn into a furry monster. Keep ears fully inside frame, never flatten head or ears to fit layout. Square production expression sheet, exactly NINE equally sized high-detail head-and-upper-shoulder portraits in a 3 by 3 grid, consistent mostly frontal camera, all ears complete and identical position/length. Expressions in reading order: composed neutral; subtle amused half-smile; warmly affectionate eyes; lightly teasing raised eyebrow; restrained irritation; startled then attentive; concerned protective; brief relaxed laugh with natural teeth; focused stern resolve. Same mature rugged face in every panel, restrained believable facial muscle changes, not caricature. Same black collar and tie. No graphic symbols or emotion labels.
reproduction_note: 文本是独立重建描述，不承诺纯文字精确复现。身份以确认胸像为准；全身头部直接等比合成，三视图正面复用母版，其余视角由内置 ImageGen 生成。
